reason: Provides two agent-facing Windows tools for screen or image description through a configured vision endpoint and verbatim text extraction through built-in OCR.

summaries.zh: 为文本智能体提供 Windows 屏幕或图片描述工具，以及使用系统内置 OCR 提取文字的工具。
summaries.en: Provides text agents with Windows screen or image descriptions through a configured vision endpoint and verbatim text extraction using built-in OCR.

capabilities: Captures the Windows screen or reads an image file
Sends captured images to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
Extracts text using Windows built-in OCR
Runs bundled PowerShell capture and OCR scripts
